Item0000000010.description: non-linear fit of the blood glucose solution to glucose tolerance test data
Item0000000010.label: determine the pre-diabetic status of a person from glucose tolerance test data

descriptions.en: non-linear fit of the blood glucose solution to glucose tolerance test data

labels.en: determine the pre-diabetic status of a person from glucose tolerance test data

value.content: The analytical solution of the glucose-hormone model for the blood glucose concentration is fitted to glucose tolerance test data, i.e. blood glucose measured at several times after the intake of a glucose meal, separately for each person. The fasting blood glucose concentration, the decay parameter, the damped angular frequency, the amplitude of the ingestion-driven blood glucose disturbance and the time constant of the digestive system are estimated by the fit. The natural angular frequency and the natural time period are then computed from the fitted values. A natural time period below 4 hours indicates a normal person, a natural time period of 4 hours or more a pre-diabetic person.
